en:
I don't know what you have planned,
but I think I'm prepared.
I've built up a tolerance to it.
Sh-Shuichi!

Hah-hahaha! You're right! It'll take a lot more
to break our relationship, huh!?

Alright, then I'll tell you my idea for my next
invention!
It's called the "Fapometer!"

It's a device that'll tell you exactly how many
times someone has jerked off!

<CLT=cltMIND>That's not so different than all
the other inventions...

<CLT=cltMIND>But if it makes her feel
better, that's good.
<CLT=cltMIND>I think this conversation went well.
I can't make any promises...

Urghhhhh...! I thought you of all people
would understand, Shuichi...

F-Fine! If that's how you're gonna be then
I won't make it!
<CLT=cltMIND>Damn, this is awkward...
Why do you treat me special, Miu?

Huh...!?
Because you're my...
Uhhhh...
Hey! Apologize to the world!

If I lose my motivation due to shock, the
world would never recover from the loss!

<CLT=cltMIND>It seems like that didn't
go well...

If you care about me that much...
then of course I will, Miu.

Hah-haha! Alright, if you wanna know that
badly, I'll tell ya!

The name of my latest invention I'm workin'
on is...
The "Pervjector"!

It analyzes the user's subconscious perverted
fantasies and projects them onto film!

Once it's finished, you can be my guinea
pig!

Then again, I already know you're into
tan older ladies with big ol' titties!
<CLT=cltMIND>I am!?

<CLT=cltMIND>Good, it seems like
we both had a lot of fun.
